properties.description: Two tests on a store in a folder, ONE MCP session as flo2 keeps per design. Behind CallerRule::TrustedGateway: the owner (seat:owner) add_requirement offers loop_hint/detect_gaps, the member (seat:member) calls detect_gaps, the owner calls graph_report, then usage_report peek (seat:reader): the cue is offered 1, followed_at_all 0, unattributable 0, and the ledger's call lines carry seat:owner, seat:member, seat:owner, seat:reader. On CallerRule::Local the same calls with the same keys: every line carries the session's own seat and the cue reads followed (1).
properties.findings: At d09ee3830 on ajs77 (rust 1.98.1, RocksDB build): 2 passed, and the whole on_disk program passed. With the host's seat disabled on the ledger line two_callers_on_one_session_are_counted_on_their_own_seats FAILED (followed_at_all 1), so the test pins the fault. flo2's real-engine test against this build: the member's call no longer follows the owner's cue at either door.
properties.name: Behind a trusted gateway, each caller's cues are counted on the seat the host names
